from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u070/system/state/workspace/programs')
root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path=root/'task-d86adeee.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = {grid[r][c]: (r, c) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c] in (1, 2)}
    r, c = points[2]
    tr, tc = points[1]
    dr = 1 if tr > r else -1 if tr < r else 0
    dc = 1 if tc > c else -1 if tc < c else 0

    # Begin one diagonal step from 2 toward 1, then use the dominant
    # axis to reach equal offsets and continue diagonally toward 1.
    r += dr
    c += dc
    while abs(tr - r) != abs(tc - c):
        if abs(tr - r) > abs(tc - c):
            r += dr
        else:
            c += dc
        if (r, c) != (tr, tc):
            out[r][c] = 3
    while (r, c) != (tr, tc):
        r += dr
        c += dc
        if (r, c) != (tr, tc):
            out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
path.write_text(source)
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task',path)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
# demo fixtures
D1=[[0]*12 for _ in range(13)]; D1[3][11]=2; D1[10][1]=1
E1=[[0]*12 for _ in range(13)]; E1[3][11]=2; E1[10][1]=1
for r,c in [(4,7),(4,8),(4,9),(4,10),(5,6),(6,5),(7,4),(8,3),(9,2)]: E1[r][c]=3
D2=[[0]*12 for _ in range(15)]; D2[1][1]=2; D2[13][8]=1
E2=[[0]*12 for _ in range(15)]; E2[1][1]=2; E2[13][8]=1
for r in range(2,8): E2[r][2]=3
for i in range(8,13): E2[i][i-5]=3
print(mod.transform(D1)==E1, mod.transform(D2)==E2)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in mod.transform(D2)))
